name: 92025 · Escondido, CA
findings: ZIP 92025 (Escondido) has 214 nonprofit organizations. 97 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92025 (Escondido) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
56% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92025 (Escondido) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
